source.title: "They are in my yard and reach up to the door": alarm grows in Matanzas over the African giant snail

en.summary: Residents in Matanzas are alarmed by invasive African giant snails reaching their doorsteps.

brief: Markets rally on peace hopes while wildfires, political scandals, and international tensions dominate the day; AI research focuses on visualization, evaluation, and integration barriers.
news_summary: ASX hits record high on peace optimism; wildfires in Washington and threats near Trump's golf course highlight security concerns; political stories include Icac findings in Australia and Missouri primary results.
papers_summary: Research highlights include datasets for hospital infections, methods for evaluating LLMs in education, and studies on AI adoption in software teams and wearable health insights.

zh.brief: 今日焦点集中在台湾汉光演习的军民结合新战略、俄罗斯伤兵被送回前线的指控，以及中国对出入境自由的新定义；学术方面则关注LLM在教育中的评估与可视化研究。
zh.news_summary: 台湾汉光演习强调军民结合与城市防御；俄罗斯被曝将伤兵重新送回前线；中国新出入境规定引发广泛讨论。
